response.sql: WITH per_driver AS (SELECT driverId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM driverStandings WHERE points >= 1.0 GROUP BY driverId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_wins FROM per_driver) SELECT p.driverId, p.avg_points, p.avg_wins, p.avg_wins - o.mean_wins AS diff FROM per_driver p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.mean_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_wins - o.mean_wins) IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10
